send_message.name: send_message
send_message.description: Send SMS/MMS from your OpenPhone number to a recipient

content.description: The text content of the message to be sent (1-1600 characters)

to.description: Recipient phone numbers in E.164 format (e.g., +15555555555)

setInboxStatus.description: Set the status of the related OpenPhone inbox conversation

aiMetadata.description: Sends an SMS/MMS text message from one of the workspace's OpenPhone numbers to a recipient. Choose this to programmatically text a contact or phone number. Requires the sending OpenPhone number (E.164 like +15555555555 or a phone-number ID) and exactly one recipient number in E.164 format; content must be 1-1600 characters. Not idempotent — each call sends a new message.

create_contact.name: create_contact
create_contact.description: Create a new contact in your OpenPhone workspace

emails.description: List of email addresses for the contact

phoneNumbers.description: List of phone numbers for the contact

value.description: The phone number (preferably in E.164 format)

key.description: The identifying key for the custom field

value.description: The value for the custom field

createdByUserId.description: The unique identifier of the user who created the contact (US123abc format)

sourceUrl.description: A link to the contact in the source system

externalId.description: A unique identifier from an external system

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new contact in the OpenPhone workspace with optional emails, phone numbers, company, role, and custom fields. Choose this when adding a brand-new person; use Update Contact to modify an existing one. First name is required. Not idempotent — each call creates a separate contact even with identical input.

update_contact.name: update_contact
update_contact.description: Update an existing contact in your OpenPhone workspace

auth.description: Enter your OpenPhone API key. You can generate one from the API tab in your workspace settings.

emails.description: List of email addresses for the contact (replaces existing emails)

value.description: The email address (set to empty to remove)

id.description: The unique identifier for existing email field (required for updates)

phoneNumbers.description: List of phone numbers for the contact (replaces existing phone numbers)

value.description: The phone number (set to empty to remove, preferably in E.164 format)

id.description: The unique identifier for existing phone number field (required for updates)

key.description: The identifying key for the custom field

value.description: The value for the custom field (set to empty to remove)

id.description: The unique identifier for the custom field (required for updates)

sourceUrl.description: Update the link to the contact in the source system

externalId.description: Update the unique identifier from an external system

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing OpenPhone contact identified by its contact ID, changing any of name, company, role, emails, phone numbers, custom fields, or source. Choose this to modify a contact that already exists rather than create one. Requires a valid contact ID and at least one field to change; supplied email/phone arrays replace the existing ones. Idempotent — re-applying the same field values leaves the contact in the same state.

get_call_summary.name: get_call_summary

phoneNumbers.description: Select a phone number to get calls from

outgoing_message_delivered.name: outgoing_message_delivered
outgoing_message_delivered.description: Fires when an outbound message is delivered successfully. Useful for message confirmation workflows.

phoneNumbers.description: Select a phone number to get calls from

outgoing_call_completed.name: outgoing_call_completed
outgoing_call_completed.description: Fires when an outbound call ends. Useful for call logging.

auth.description: Enter your OpenPhone API key. You can generate one from the API tab in your workspace settings.

phoneNumbers.description: Select a phone number to get calls from

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an outbound (workspace-initiated) call ends, delivering the completed call details. Incoming calls are filtered out, so this only represents calls placed from the OpenPhone number. Use for call logging or post-call automation. Can be scoped to a specific OpenPhone number or all numbers.

incoming_call_completed.name: incoming_call_completed
incoming_call_completed.description: Fires when an incoming call is completed. Includes voicemail data if available.

phoneNumbers.description: Select a phone number to get calls from

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an inbound call to the OpenPhone number ends, delivering the completed call details including voicemail data when present. Outbound calls are filtered out, so this only represents received calls. Use for inbound-call logging, voicemail handling, or follow-up. Can be scoped to a specific OpenPhone number or all numbers.

incoming_message_received.name: incoming_message_received
incoming_message_received.description: Fires when a new SMS/MMS message is received.

phoneNumbers.description: Select a phone number to get calls from

pt.OpenPhone number to send from (E.164 for: Número OpenPhone para enviar do formato (E.164: +15555555555) ou ID do telefone (PN123abc)
pt.Recipient phone numbers in E.164 format: Números de telefone do beneficiário no formato E.164 (por exemplo, +1555555555555)
pt.The unique identifier of the OpenPhone u: O identificador exclusivo do usuário OpenPhone enviando a mensagem. Se não for fornecido, o padrão é o proprietário do número de telefone.
pt.Set the status of the related OpenPhone: Definir o status da conversa relacionada com o OpenPhone
pt.The contact's company name: O nome do contato da empresa
pt.List of email addresses for the contact: Lista de endereços de e-mail para o contato
pt.List of phone numbers for the contact: Lista de números de telefone para o contato
pt.The unique identifier of the user who cr: O identificador exclusivo do usuário que criou o contato (formato US123abc)
pt.The contact's source (defaults to \"publ: A fonte do contato (o padrão é "public-api")
pt.A link to the contact in the source syst: Um link para o contato no sistema de origem
pt.A unique identifier from an external sys: Um identificador exclusivo de um sistema externo
pt.List of email addresses for the contact: Lista de endereços de e-mail para o contato (substituir e-mails existentes)
pt.List of phone numbers for the contact (r: Lista de números de telefone para o contato (substitui os números de telefone existentes)
pt.Update the link to the contact in the so: Atualizar o link para o contato no sistema de origem
pt.Update the unique identifier from an ext: Atualizar o identificador exclusivo de um sistema externo
pt.Select a phone number to get calls from: Selecione um número de telefone de onde quer receber chamadas
pt.Select a participant phone number to fil: Selecione um número de telefone do usuário para filtrar chamadas
pt.Fires when a call recording finishes. Us: Atira quando termina a gravação de chamada. Útil para fluxos de trabalho pós-transcrição ou arquivamento.
pt.Fires when an outbound message is delive: Atira quando uma mensagem de saída é entregue com sucesso. Útil para fluxos de trabalho de confirmação de mensagem.
pt.Fires when an outbound call ends. Useful: Atira quando uma chamada de saída termina. Útil para registro de chamadas.
pt.Fires when an incoming call is completed: Efetua quando uma chamada recebida é concluída. Inclui dados de correio de voz se disponível.
pt.Fires when a new SMS/MMS message is rece: Efetua quando uma nova mensagem de SMS/MMS é recebida.
